description: Records what happened with an application: its status (accepted, shipping, earning, declined…), the discount code and tracking link the brand gave, and notes. A brand's reply to the deals address usually fills these in by itself. With a code or link on an accepted program, brand_program_to_bio puts it on the bio page.

idempotency_key.description: Any unique string, e.g. a UUID. A retry with the same key within 24 hours returns the first call's result instead of doing it again.

workspace.description: Workspace ID. Optional when the connection has a default or only one workspace.

name: brand_application_update
title: Update a brand program
